name: prescription-engine
description: Louis Performance System — Prescription Engine (V0.4 scaffold). Sibling package to planning-engine and head-coach-engine: resolves a single planning-engine session (kind + doseTarget) into a concrete exercise/drill prescription by selecting from planning-engine's catalogues (docs/11_DECISION_LOG.md, V0.4_119 -> V0.4_130 design/prep audits). Depends on planning-engine for its prescription types, catalogues, and validatePrescriptionStructure; never imports head-coach-engine internals.

scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
